title: The Second Company Mona Ataya Had Not Planned to Start
conflicts: Launch month: November 2011 in Ataya's own account (Images RetailME 2013) versus October 2011 (Wamda 2018); the story uses her November date for the site and 'a month earlier' for the announcement. Product and brand counts differ by year and outlet (e.g. 120,000 versus 140,000 products, both in 2017; 6,000 versus 5,500 brands), so only the launch figure of 15,000 is used. The speed of the first round (oversubscribed in six weeks) is Ataya's own claim and is attributed to her; $50 million total raised rests on Wamda 2021 alone and is given as 'about'. Infobae (2022) was set aside because it misdates Bayt.com's founding to 2011.
notes: Co-founder Leena Khalil is named. Quote stance is 'complicates': Seneca on rest set against Ataya's description of a job with no off-switch. The Gulf News interview's original date is not shown (page updated July 2022), so the story does not date that remark.
